statements.impact_statement: The official Spring advisory requires XsltView and an implicit view name reached through a /** view-rendering mapping. AssetPulse's tested MVC configuration uses response-body API handlers, has no XsltView or XSLT view resolver, and does not render XSLT for unmapped requests. This statement applies only to this AssetPulse application and exact Spring MVC dependency version; reassess when its MVC configuration or dependency version changes. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47884/
